candidates.statement: Checkout returns 502 after ~2s because the order service's call to payment (/v1/authorizations) hits a transport ReadTimeout; payment is the slow downstream. Inventory/redis calls succeed quickly, so the failure is bounded to the payment dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side latency metrics or logs; payment slowness inferred from client-side ReadTimeout only.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout failing with 502 after ~2s: order->payment POST /v1/authorizations raises transport ReadTimeout, while inventory/redis reservations succeed. Gateway metrics show /v1/checkout 502s and p95 ~2406ms. Bounded candidate is downstream payment latency; payment-side evidence is still required to confirm.
missing_evidence: Payment service server-side latency/error metrics to confirm payment is the slow dependency
Payment service logs or traces for the timed-out authorization requests
Order service dependency-operation metrics (empty in current metrics query)
